summary_zh: 本页为绘本《夜晚》的封面，展示了星空和月亮的夜景，标明了书名、作者、译者及出版社信息。

page_text_ocr_zh:
天渐渐黑了……
Darkness falls slowly ...
就像一条毛茸茸的毯子一样覆盖着大地。
like a fuzzy blanket tucking in the world.
你的身体感觉有点累了，“啊……哈……”
该去睡觉啦。
Your body grows tired. Y-a-w-w-w-n. Time to sleep.
page_text_en:
The sky grows dark...
Darkness falls slowly ...
Like a fuzzy blanket covering the world.
like a fuzzy blanket tucking in the world.
Your body feels a bit tired, "Yawn..."

summary_zh: 本页描绘了黄昏时分的乡村景象，天空渐暗，文字描述夜晚如毛茸茸的毯子覆盖大地，提示身体感到疲倦，该去睡觉了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
皎洁的月光
Glow
月亮有时高高的，像一张歪头笑的脸；有时低低的，像一个懒洋洋的南瓜。它在夜空中穿行，洒下一片明亮的月光。
The moon hangs high like a lop-sided smile or rides low like a lazy pumpkin. It paints a trail of light as it moves across the night sky.
page_text_en:
Glow
The moon sometimes hangs high, like a crooked smiling face; sometimes low, like a lazy pumpkin. It travels across the night sky, casting a bright trail of moonlight.
The moon hangs high like a lop-sided smile or rides low like a lazy pumpkin. It paints a trail of light as it moves across the night sky.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了夜晚明亮的月光洒在湖面上的景象，文字用拟人化的比喻描述月亮的形态和移动，营造出宁静的夜景氛围。

page_text_ocr_zh:

page_text_en:
A white river of stars flows across the night sky—that is the Milky Way.
A milky river of stars streams across the sky.
Constellations such as Ursa Major, Draco, and Scorpius sparkle in the dark.
Constellations—a bear, a dragon, a scorpion—sparkle in the dark.
summary_zh: 本页展示了沙漠夜空下的仙人掌和银河景象，文字介绍了银河和大熊座、天龙座、天蝎座等星座，右侧插图描绘了成人与儿童用望远镜观星的场景。

page_text_ocr_zh:

page_text_en:
Constellations

Long, long ago, people drew imaginary lines between stars, connecting some stars to form different pictures. These groups of connected stars are called constellations.
For a long time, people have drawn imaginary, or pretend, lines from star to star, creating pictures in groups of stars. These groups are called constellations.

Constellations are like maps in the sky. There are 88 of them.

Can you tell what constellation this is?

This is Ursa Major. The yellow lines connect the Big Dipper.

In which kind of weather is it easier to see constellations—cloudy or clear?

This is Orion. Can you find it in the night sky?
summary_zh: 本页介绍了星座的概念，解释了人们如何通过连接星星形成星座，并指出天空中共有88个星座。页面通过多个圆形插图展示了大熊座、猎户座等星座，并配有互动性问题引导读者观察。

这只毛茸茸的浣熊发现了它的零食。

page_text_en:
Shy deer emerge from the trees. Opossums, skunks, and raccoons wander through moon shadows.

summary_zh: 本页描绘了夜晚森林中多种动物的活动，左侧文字介绍鹿、负鼠、臭鼬和浣熊在月影下漫步，右侧图片展示一只浣熊在树干上发现食物的场景。

summary_zh: 本页描绘了夜晚森林中猫头鹰俯冲捕鼠和蝙蝠在空中飞舞捕食昆虫的场景，通过文字和图片展现了夜行性动物的活跃状态。

page_text_ocr_zh:
夜晚，院子里、农田里、草原上、雪山上、雨林里以及沙漠中，到处都有动物们活动的踪迹。
At night, animals wander through yards and farm fields, savannas and snowy mountains, rain forests and dusty deserts.
page_text_en:
At night, animals wander through yards and farm fields, savannas and snowy mountains, rain forests and dusty deserts.
At night, animals wander through yards and farm fields, savannas and snowy mountains, rain forests and dusty deserts.
summary_zh: 本页展示了夜晚不同生态环境中动物的活动，左侧文字说明动物在院子、农田、草原、雪山、雨林和沙漠中都有踪迹，右侧图片描绘了月光下一群狮子在草原上行走的场景，左上角和左下角分别有壁虎和野猫的特写插图。

page_text_ocr_zh:
动物们, 起床啦!
Wake Up, Animals!
跟我们人类一样, 动物也需要睡觉, 但不同的是, 很多动物是夜行性的, 喜欢白天睡觉, 晚上出来活动。
All people and animals need sleep. But unlike people, many animals are nocturnal—which means they are most active at night.
夜行性动物在黑暗中的视力比人类好得多! 它们在晚上照样可以轻轻松松地追踪、捕获猎物。
Nocturnal animals see better in the dark than people do. They can follow a trail or chase a meal without bumping into things.
你在户外过夜过吗?
你起床的时候, 天是黑的还是亮的?
你用过手电筒吗?
你在黑暗中能看见东西吗?
page_text_en:
Wake Up, Animals!
Just like humans, animals need sleep. But unlike people, many animals are nocturnal—which means they are most active at night.
Nocturnal animals see better in the dark than people do. They can follow a trail or chase a meal without bumping into things.
Have you ever spent a night outdoors?
When you wake up, is it dark or light outside?
Have you ever used a flashlight?
Can you see things in the dark?
summary_zh: 本页介绍了夜行性动物的特点，说明它们在夜间活动且视力优于人类，并通过猫头鹰、狐狸、浣熊等动物的图片和互动问题引导读者思考夜间生活。

page_text_ocr_zh:
夜晚为沙漠带来了凉爽的空气。动物们匆匆地从洞穴中出来寻找食物，它们有些是毛茸茸的，有些全身长着鳞片。
Night brings cool air to the desert. Scaly and furry animals hurry from burrows to find food.
不管是捕食者还是猎物，都可以借助夜色把自己藏起来。
Darkness helps hide predators ... and their prey.
page_text_en:
Night brings cool air to the desert. Animals hurry from burrows to find food. Some are furry, some are scaly.
Night brings cool air to the desert. Scaly and furry animals hurry from burrows to find food.
Whether predator or prey, darkness helps hide them.
Darkness helps hide predators ... and their prey.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了夜晚沙漠中动物的活动，说明它们在凉爽的夜间从洞穴中出来觅食，并指出夜色能帮助捕食者和猎物隐藏自己。页面左侧展示了一只蜥蜴，右侧展示了耳廓狐和刺猬的图片。

page_text_ocr_zh:
追击!
Chase!

Through spring, summer, autumn, and winter, animals around the world snoop, sneak, hide, seek, leap, fly, and scramble through the night.
page_text_en:
Chase!
Chase!
Spring, summer, autumn, and winter, every night around the world, animals are busy searching for food. All night long, they are scouting, sneaking, hiding, seeking, leaping, flying, or scrambling up and down.
Through spring, summer, autumn, and winter, animals around the world snoop, sneak, hide, seek, leap, fly, and scramble through the night.
summary_zh: 本页以“追击！”为主题，介绍了世界各地动物在四季夜晚为觅食而进行的各种活动，如侦察、潜行、攀爬等，并配以树栖猴、田鼠和豹子的图片，展现夜行性动物的活跃状态。

page_text_en:

summary_zh: 本页描绘了日出时分雪山的壮丽景象，并通过文字描述太阳唤醒世界，同时呼应屋内孩子醒来的情景，标志着夜晚结束、新的一天开始。

page_text_ocr_zh:

Shhh. Animals grow tired. Y-a-w-w-w-n.

page_text_en:
Stars fade ...
Shhh. Animals that are active at night are getting tired.
"Ah...哈..." They yawn, some crawl back into their burrows, some snuggle in the snow, some rest their heads on their legs, slowly closing their eyes... waiting for the next night to come.
Shhh. Animals grow tired. Y-a-w-w-w-n.
They crawl into burrows or snuggle in the snow or sprawl on a limb to close their eyes ... and wait for nighttime.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了夜行性动物在夜晚结束时感到疲倦并准备休息的场景，文字说明它们打哈欠、回到洞穴或雪地、闭上眼睛等待下一个夜晚，配图是一只正在树干上睡觉的浣熊。

page_text_ocr_zh:
光明和阴影
Light and Shadow
地球在绕着太阳公转的同时，也在慢慢地自转。所以，当你生活的地方是白天时，地球的另一面就是夜晚哦！
Earth slowly rotates as it circles the sun. So when it's daytime where you live, it's nighttime on the other side of the world.
月球绕着地球转一圈大约要用一个月的时间。由于月球在不停地转动，它在天空中的形状看上去会有所改变。其实月球一直都是圆的，看不见的那部分是被地球的影子遮住了。
Every month or so, the moon makes one trip around Earth. As it travels, it looks like the moon is changing shape in the sky. The moon is still round, but part of it is in Earth's shadow.
